arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Fisher argued the case involves a procedural injury. She stated the denial of access to DNA evidence is the core issue. She noted the opposing sides changed their standing rationale during the proceedings.

Mr. Cole argued the declaratory judgment did not redress the injury. He stated the injury is the denial of access to DNA testing evidence. He referenced the Reed case to support his position on justifications.

Justice Alito asked if the side that brought the case must show a declaratory judgment redresses his injury. He noted the defendant is the district attorney. He sought confirmation on the redress requirement.

Justice Sotomayor asked if Article III standing requires a particularized determination. She asked if a specific state official will redress the injury. She noted the lower court did not reach due process arguments.

paragraphs: This dispute defines the scope of federal court power over state prison procedures. It determines whether prisoners can use federal courts to challenge state DNA testing rules. The outcome shapes access to post-conviction evidence for all state prisoners.
